pageTitle: Monster Spots · Creatures of the Deep Guide
pageDescription: A Creatures of the Deep monster spot guide with boat position maps, Monster Bait placement photos, and tips for finding bubbles and fishing.
fieldTitle: Find your spot. Plan your cast.
fieldBody: Monster Bait helps locate monsters. If bubbles appear, cast there and wait for a bite.
heroDescription: Choose a map, position your boat, then check the bait photos.
dateHint: Choose a map to see the location. Use these spots as a guide and check conditions in-game.
activePointLabel: Spot {point}, reference for the selected date
waterAlt: {name}, spot {point}, Monster Bait reference {index}; approximate area only
missingWaterHint: Try another spot for a reference photo.
waterHint: Photos show an {area}. After using bait, cast at the bubbles.
enlargeMap: Enlarge the boat-position map for {name}, spot {point}
missingMapHint: Use the terrain in the reference photo to estimate where to stop your boat.
mapCaption: Match the shoreline to position your boat. Select a number to view another spot.
step1: Position your boat using the map or photo.
step2: Use Monster Bait in the reference area and watch for bubbles.
step3: If bubbles appear, cast there and wait for a bite.
stepsNote: Bait helps locate monsters but is not required to catch them. Check the monster's active hours, too.
footerTagline: Know where to stop. Know where to cast.
viewerMapDescription: Map reference: use it to position your boat.
viewerNavigationHint: Click either edge or use ← → to browse
viewerSwipeHint: Use the arrows or buttons below, or swipe to browse
viewerPanHint: Drag or scroll to explore. Select the percentage to reset.
viewerSingleHint: Use + below to zoom in for detail
copyDescription: Automatic copying was unavailable. Select the text below and copy it manually.
copyHeader: Monster reference spots for {date} — {region} (updated at {hour}:00, device local time)
copyFooter: Spots are a guide only. Monster Bait can help locate monsters; if bubbles appear, cast there and wait.
helpSubtitle: Choose a map, find your spot, check the bait photos.
helpPositionBody: Choose a map and find the highlighted number. Match the shorelines and islands to position your boat. Select another number to switch spots.
helpBaitBody: Use shorelines, islands, and buildings to match the scene, then place Monster Bait. If bubbles appear, cast there and wait for a bite.
helpBaitOptional: Bait helps locate monsters but is optional. Check the monster's active hours.
helpResetBody: Change the date in Overview, or select Today to return. Results update at 05:00 for North America and 04:00 elsewhere, using device local time. The previous day applies until then.
helpAtlasBody: Open a photo, then tap either edge, swipe, or use the arrow keys to browse. When zoomed in, drag to explore. Closing the viewer keeps your current photo.
helpDataNote: Spots are estimated from a community 26-day cycle and are a guide only.
mapPickerHint: {date} · Switch maps, or resume your current map.
mapZoomHint: Zoom in, then scroll to explore
markerPlaceHint: Click the map to place the marker
markerPending: Boat position for spot {point} is not confirmed
markerPendingHint: Use the base map and scene references for now. Unconfirmed positions are not marked.
editorIntro: Choose a spot, compare references, place and verify. Save for the next site release.
editorLocalOnly: Open this workspace through npm run dev locally.
editorStorageWarning: Browser draft storage is unavailable or unreadable. Export a JSON backup.
editorRecoverHint: An unsaved browser draft is available.
editorRecoverConflict: An older draft exists, but project data has changed. Export it for reference and keep the current project data to avoid overwriting newer edits.
editorImported: Imported into the workspace; undo is available. Review before saving to the project.
editorImportInvalid: Import failed: invalid format, map, spot, coordinates, or file larger than 128 KB.
editorPreviewHint: Release preview: only confirmed markers on the current base map are shown. You can still switch maps and spots.
editorSaved: Saved to the project with a backup of the previous version. Commit and merge your changes, then publish a stable release to update the site.
editorConflict: Save blocked: project data or base maps changed. Export a draft backup, then reload and review.
editorSaveFailed: Save failed. Check the local development server.
editorBaseChanged: The base map has changed. Existing coordinates require review and will not appear on the public site.
editorReviewBase: Use current base and reset to drafts
editorPlaceHelp: Choose a spot and enable placement. Click to place; zoom and scroll to inspect.
editorNoteHint: For example: northwest of the central island, near the shallows.
editorConfirmHint: Verify against the game map, shorelines and scene references. Coordinate or note edits reset confirmation.
editorReferenceHelp: Match shorelines, islands, and buildings in the photos to place the boat marker on the map.
editorPublish1: Confirm each checked position. Partial releases are supported.
editorPublish2: Save to the project, then run npm test and npm run build.
editorPublish3: Commit coordinates and base map assets, then merge into main through a PR. Create a version tag and publish a stable GitHub Release to update the site.
